segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, first page's castle entry) to the Castle. Its Lua runs des.drawbridge in the table form with dir east and state closed through lspo_drawbridge and dbridge.c create_drawbridge, and des.mazewalk in the positional (x, y, dir) form through lspo_mazewalk, once west and once east, each stocked through fill_empty_maze. It also runs des.non_diggable with a selection through set_wallprop_in_selection. The seed was chosen without a search: every seed reaches the Castle from the menu.
